description: CMU mocap BVH (cgspeed conversion) joint naming = Mixamo names without the mixamorig: prefix. The cgspeed hierarchy is Hips > LowerBack > Spine > Spine1 - there is NO Spine2 joint (unlike real Mixamo rigs, see mixamo.json). Chest therefore maps to Spine1, the joint the shoulders hang from, and there is deliberately no spine2 role: mapping spine2 to Spine1 as well would double-drive the same joint. The LowerBack and HipJoint nodes are unmapped intermediates; the bake's rest-offset transfer accounts for unmapped ancestors exactly.
